name: LaCenterra at Cinco Ranch
summary: LaCenterra at Cinco Ranch is Katy's premier outdoor lifestyle center featuring a sophisticated mix of retail shops, restaurants, and professional offices in a walkable town square setting. Located in the heart of the affluent Cinco Ranch master-planned community, this open-air destination serves as both a shopping venue and community gathering place.
demographics: LaCenterra at Cinco Ranch attracts an affluent, family-oriented demographic from the master-planned Cinco Ranch community and surrounding Katy suburbs. The primary trade area consists of upper-middle-class households with median incomes exceeding $100,000, featuring young professionals and families with children. Shoppers typically range from 30-55 years old with high educational attainment and strong purchasing power. The center serves as a community gathering place for residents seeking convenient access to upscale retail, dining, and professional services in a walkable outdoor setting.
description: LaCenterra at Cinco Ranch stands as Katy's premier outdoor lifestyle destination, seamlessly blending shopping, dining, and professional services within the heart of the master-planned Cinco Ranch community. Developed as a mixed-use town center, this open-air shopping venue features a carefully curated collection of national retailers, local boutiques, and restaurants arranged along tree-lined walkways and gathering spaces that encourage community interaction. The center's design reflects a commitment to creating an authentic town square atmosphere, with business offices integrated into the upper levels and retail experiences at street level. Visitors enjoy a diverse tenant mix ranging from fashion and footwear retailers to beauty shops and gift stores, complemented by an impressive array of dining options that make LaCenterra a popular evening and weekend destination. With its convenient location on Cinco Ranch Boulevard and reputation for quality tenants and well-maintained facilities, LaCenterra has become the social and commercial hub for one of Houston's most desirable suburban communities.
